title: New average-price field divides by zero for empty carts (ZeroDivisionError)
rca_root_cause: ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero at app/pricing.py:28 in compute_total(). The failing code was most recently changed by commit 40f4385 "Show item count and average item price on order totals" by Rahul Verma, shipped in deployment v1.4.0.
patch_diff:
diff --git a/app/pricing.py b/app/pricing.py
index 1f162d6..dea801f 100644
--- a/app/pricing.py
+++ b/app/pricing.py
@@ -24,13 +24,9 @@ def compute_total(order, coupon_code=None):
         discount = apply_discount(subtotal, coupon)
     taxable = subtotal - discount
     tax = round(taxable * GST_RATE, 2)
-    item_count = sum(item["qty"] for item in order["items"])
-    average_item_price = round(subtotal / item_count, 2)
     return {
         "order_id": order["id"],
         "coupon": coupon_code.upper() if coupon_code else None,
-        "item_count": item_count,
-        "average_item_price": average_item_price,
         "subtotal": subtotal,
         "discount": discount,
         "tax": tax,
diff --git a/tests/test_pricing.py b/tests/test_pricing.py
index 45f1ac6..226ee67 100644
--- a/tests/test_pricing.py
+++ b/tests/test_pricing.py
@@ -16,9 +16,3 @@ def test_welcome_coupon_discount():
     result = pricing.compute_total(catalog.get_order(1002), "WELCOME10")
     assert result["discount"] == round(15999.00 * 0.10, 2)
     assert result["coupon"] == "WELCOME10"
-
-
-def test_average_item_price():
-    result = pricing.compute_total(catalog.get_order(1001))
-    assert result["item_count"] == 3
-    assert result["average_item_price"] == round((3499.00 + 2 * 899.00) / 3, 2)

title: Expired coupon crashes pricing (TypeError)

@@ -1,22 +1,12 @@

-# code -> (percent off, maximum discount in rupees, valid until)
